What if you swallowed toothpaste every day?
Most toothpaste contains fluoride, which helps prevent cavities. A tiny bit happens to everyone. Adults should spit, not swallow, and you don't even need to rinse.

But here's the twist. That's why kids under three should use only a rice grain sized smear, because swallowing too much fluoride while teeth grow can cause white spots! For kids three to six, a pea sized amount is enough. If a kid swallows a lot of toothpaste, call poison control right away.
